thread:
maria: heads up — seeing intermittent ptls cert chain mismatch on requests from eu-edge -> internal-infer. Errors started shortly after the keystore rotator run. logs show `x509: certificate signed by unknown authority` for backend-03 :eyes:
ken: ugh. errors only in eu-west? any cross-region surface?
maria: mostly eu-west1 and eu-central, not us-west. error rate ~0.4% of requests, started ~09:39 UTC. snippet:
```
2026-03-22T09:40:12Z backend-03 ERROR x509: certificate signed by unknown authority (peer CN=svc-edge-eu)
2026-03-22T09:40:12Z proxy-12 WARN chain length 2, expected 3
```
ash: can you paste the subject/issuer chain from one of the failing certs? my hunch is rotator published leaf+root but intermediate missing on some proxies.
maria: failing cert chain (from tcpdump):
- Subject: CN=svc-edge-eu, O=redwood-internal
- Issuer: CN=redwood-intermediate, O=redwood
- Root: CN=redwood-root
Looks like intermediate not present when the proxy served the cert.
samir: quick check — did the rotator change which KMS key alias it uses? last RBAC tweak I saw restricted `rotator-service` from kms:Decrypt at 3309993000 during the RBAC cleanup. @ken any IAM changes near that time?
ken: I rolled back an RBAC tweak earlier but that was for vault-provisioner, not rotator. will grep audit logs now.
maria: audit logs show Decrypt successes up to 09:38 and then a burst of Deny for service=rotator eu-west1 at 09:39:21 — looks like a propagation/L4 deny issue.
jess: if rotator couldn't unwrap the intermediate, it may have pushed an incomplete chain. Manual remediation: re-run rotator with `--force-publish --preload-intermediate` for affected regions.
ash: also we should add a temporary proxy fallback to accept the previous full-chain for 1 hour while we validate. that avoids mass failures during rollout.
samir: opening incident ticket INC-33099 and paging eng-oncall. @rotator-bot can you requeue the last publish job for eu regions?
rotator-bot: queued job 4782 to republish cert chain to eu regions — ETA ~2m :white_check_mark:
maria: confirmation — after republish, proxies started serving full chain at 09:44 and errors dropped to ~0.02%. keeping monitors on for 30m.
ken: follow-ups (action items):
- Add an audit alert for kms:Decrypt "Deny" spike (threshold: >5 denies/min per region).
- Expand rotator integration test to validate cross-region keystore unwrap and chain completeness.
- Add a rollback playbook for RBAC changes that affect rotator KMS access.
jess: I'll own the documentation PR for the rollback playbook + example commands.
nash: I'll own the alert PR and add runbook link to pager duty.
maria: thanks — leaving a note to run a small canary rotation in apac to validate before next global run.
ken: also add a quick post-rotation cert-check job to the rotator pipeline that probes a small set of proxies and validates chain length + issuer presence (fail the run if mismatch).
samir: agreed. I'll update the incident with the action items and link the audit logs.
maria: thanks all. will close INC-33099 when follow-ups are complete. :thumbsup:
